description: The policy matrix frozen at gate CD-G0 on 2026-11-15 (plan section 7, ADR-108 D2), and how this contract encodes it. `cell` is the frozen wording of ADR-108 D2; `mode` is the value the profile carries. What a mode means in a row is its cell, decided by the broker's rule theory (CD-W03). `custom_modes` lists what a named custom profile may set. `modes` lists the modes from the least to the most permissive, which is the order an expansion is measured in.

careful.cell: Ask for a grant bound to the requested fields and date window; reads inside it run for the grant's duration

rows.operation: Create owner-only event in Agent Drafts
Create event in a selected existing calendar

flexible.cell: Allow in a user-created grant naming the calendars
Allow in an accepted scoped grant if no new recipients
Ask by default; Allow only for an approved recipient set

rules_in_every_profile.rule: An invitation to an address outside every approved recipient set is held for the owner's approval in every profile, custom ones included.
rules_in_every_profile.encoding: A recipient rule names exact addresses or recipient sets; no rule covers everyone, and no profile field widens it.

rules_in_every_profile.rule: Deleting an event asks in every profile, custom ones included, and only for an event Fabric created.
Deleting a calendar or changing sharing is blocked in every profile.
rules_in_every_profile.encoding: profile_rows fixes delete_calendar_or_change_sharing to block, and no agent tool exists for it.
